# Kagōunga

> Five distinct forms of expression bound by one identity. Gastronomy, personal
> care, home fragrance, sonic identity, and fine art from North Moluccas.

Canonical site: [https://kagounga.com](https://kagounga.com) (apex canonical, www 301-redirects to apex).

- [About](https://kagounga.com/about): company profile, milestones, and heritage.
- [News](https://kagounga.com/news): press releases and articles; articles live under `/news/:slug`.
- [Catalog](https://kagounga.com/catalog): product lineup; ordering happens via WhatsApp.
- [Music](https://kagounga.com/music): Kagōunga sonic identity and recordings.
- [Contact](https://kagounga.com/contact): inquiries and store information.
- [Editorial Policy](https://kagounga.com/editorial): how pages are researched, reviewed, and corrected.
- [Sitemap](https://kagounga.com/sitemap.xml): all crawlable URLs.
- [Image sitemap](https://kagounga.com/sitemap-images.xml): crawlable image URLs.
